title: This Lake Hits 140 Degrees and Preserves Animals Like Statues

scenes.text: This lake in Africa preserves animals like statues.
Lake Natron's water can reach 140 degrees Fahrenheit.
It is loaded with natron, a salt mix that makes it extremely alkaline.
The pH hits 10.5, close to ammonia.
Dead animals wash ashore dried, stiff and chemically preserved.
Yet millions of flamingos breed there, safe from predators.

description:
Lake Natron can reach 140 degrees Fahrenheit and a pH of 10.5, and it can leave animals chemically preserved.
Still, flamingos breed on its shores, safe from predators.
Would you visit?
first_comment: Would you visit the deadliest-looking lake on Earth?
